d:
After Rajiv Gandhi’s assassination on May 21, 1991, Sonia Gandhi was kept away from his body for hours. In her memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love, she recounts how she first learnt about his death, why she was not allowed to see his body immediately, and the moment she saw Rahul Gandhi standing beside his father’s mortal remains. She also recalls the security threats Rajiv had faced and Rahul’s warning about his father’s safety. These are Sonia Gandhi’s personal recollections of one of the most painful moments of her life.
